page: The OVHcloud l40s-180 is a dedicated GPU-accelerated server built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 30 dedicated physical cores powered by an AMD EPYC 9124 processor running at a base frequency of 2.75 GHz. The system is equipped with 180 GB of system memory, providing 6.0 GB of RAM per core. For hardware acceleration, it integrates two NVIDIA L40S GPUs from the Ada Lovelace architecture, delivering a combined 96 GB of VRAM. Local storage consists of a 400 GB NVMe SSD, and network connectivity is supported by a 16 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark results highlight top-tier performance in large language model inference. Prompt processing and text generation speeds for small, medium, and large models consistently rank in the top 10% of tested systems. Additionally, the server demonstrates strong CPU capabilities, with stress-ng single-core and multi-core performance, PassMark CPU scores, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression placing in the top 25%. Memory bandwidth for small cached blocks is also strong, though uncached large-block read and write speeds perform in the average range.

Given the inclusion of dual high-capacity GPUs and dedicated AMD EPYC cores, the server offers a specialized hardware profile tailored for resource-intensive compute tasks. It represents a dense configuration for workloads that require high VRAM and parallel processing capabilities without the overhead of larger multi-GPU clusters. This makes the l40s-180 highly suitable for LLM inference, machine learning model training, database operations, and high-throughput cryptographic or decompression tasks.
